response:
I’m glad you shared your idea—Apple does hear a lot of feedback from users like you.  
At this time there isn’t a setting to require a passcode to power off the device or to remove airplane mode from the locked Control Center.  
If you’d like to make the phone less vulnerable, you can enable Find My iPhone and the “Erase Device” option, so it’s harder to use if it’s stolen.  
Thank you for helping us improve the experience!
